theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_pfb_c1_compact_perturbation
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (O K : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsOpen O → IsCompact K → K ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O → ∃ (φ : Euclid P → Euclid P) (V K' : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen V ∧ K ⊆ V ∧ IsCompact K' ∧ K' ⊆ O ∧ ContDiff ℝ 1 φ ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, φ x = f x ∧ fderiv ℝ φ x = fderiv ℝ f x) ∧ ∀ x, x ∉ K' → φ x = x
